finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). Root cause: the bundler bump changed the options shape it hands to modules, and two call sites weren't updated for it:

1. `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted `true`/`false` and threw on anything else, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` rather than defaulting to `false`. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

The rest of the ~950 lines (DEP0xxx notices, tree-shaking notes, dedupe passes) is just noise from the version bump — those are genuine deprecation warnings but not build-breaking, so I left them alone.
